name: yargix
description: AI coding agent for your editor — agentic chat, inline autocomplete, semantic search, and local models

commands.title: YargiX: Fix Last Failed Terminal Command
YargiX: Apply and Jump to Next Edit

yargix.maxResponseLength.description: Maximum response length in tokens (0 = let the model decide)

yargix.enableWorkspaceContext.description: Enable workspace context for the AI agent

yargix.enableTerminalSuggestions.description: Enable run terminal command suggestions tool

yargix.systemPrompt.default: You are a professional coding assistant extension named YargiX.
yargix.systemPrompt.description: System prompt or custom instruction field

yargix.inlineCompletions.enabled.description: Enable Copilot-style inline (ghost-text) autocomplete powered by the selected model

yargix.inlineCompletions.model.description: Model id for inline autocomplete. Empty = use the selected chat model.

yargix.inlineCompletions.debounceMs.description: Delay in ms after typing stops before requesting a completion

yargix.inlineCompletions.maxTokens.description: Maximum tokens generated per inline completion

yargix.mcpServer.allowMutatingTools.description: Also expose file-writing and shell tools over MCP (read-only by default)

yargix.mcpServer.enabled.description: Expose YargiX's tools to external MCP clients over loopback HTTP

yargix.mcpServer.port.description: Port for the local MCP server (127.0.0.1 only)

yargix.terminal.showFixButton.description: Show a status-bar button to fix the last failed terminal command

yargix.plan.requireApproval.description: Require your approval of the plan before the agent leaves plan mode and starts implementing

yargix.fallbackModels.description: Models to fall back to, in order, when the active model fails mid-run (provider outage, quota, retired model)

yargix.agent.selfCheck.description: Before finishing a run that changed files, make the agent re-read its edits and run the project checks

yargix.browser.executablePath.description: Full path to Chrome/Edge/Chromium for the Browser tool. Empty = auto-detect.

yargix.browser.headless.description: Run the Browser tool headless. Turn off to watch the agent drive the page.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with YargiX
walkthroughs.description: Connect a model, ask your first question, and learn how to undo anything.

steps.title: Connect a model
steps.description:
Use a Claude/ChatGPT/Gemini subscription you already pay for, paste an API key, or run entirely offline with llama.cpp or Ollama.
[Open settings](command:yargix.openSettings)

steps.title: Ask about your code
steps.description:
Open the panel and ask in plain language. Attach files, docs, git history or your terminal with @.
[Open YargiX](command:yargix.chatView.focus)

steps.title: Edit code in place
steps.description:
Select code and press Ctrl+I to rewrite it from a description. Alt+Enter propagates the change everywhere else it is needed.
[Try inline edit](command:yargix.inlineEdit)

steps.title: Stay in control
steps.description:
Approve what matters, keep or undo edits hunk by hunk, review every changed file, and rewind a whole run.
[Open the Changes view](command:yargix.changesView.focus)

steps.title: Go further
steps.description:
Browser control, a memory that survives sessions, a team of specialists, a terminal CLI, and the MCP catalog.
[Browse the MCP catalog](command:yargix.openSettings)

scripts.compile: pnpm run check-types && pnpm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: pnpm run check-types && pnpm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.vsix: pnpm run package && pnpm dlx @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies
scripts.pretest:integration: pnpm run compile-tests && pnpm run compile && pnpm run lint
